system.description:
Where other Obfuscate demands you stay close to what you hide, Cache lets the concealment linger long after you have walked away.

The item or person must be within the normal range of the Obfuscate power when you activate it. Then spend a Willpower Trait to layer Cache atop the existing Obfuscate effect. The concealment persists as long as you remain within a number of miles equal to your permanent Mental Traits. It ends at the next sunrise, or when the concealed subject chooses to reveal themselves, whichever comes first.
system.duration: Until next sunrise or the subject reveals themselves
